notablePrerequisites: Helga does not have summoning sickness and has power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least {4} that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or creature spells with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Helga triggers, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Helga.
Repeat.
